messages:
zara: opening a tiny PR to modernize the quickstart: embed a CodeSandbox example, add a GitHub Pages deploy button, and add SDK v6 migration notes. draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612

paul.m: nice. can we standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY for the env var? also please include a 2-line PowerShell example for Windows users (we get a lot of those issues).

zara: switched to REDWOOD_API_KEY and added PowerShell line:
```
$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = 'sk_test_xxx'
```

kevin.docs: quick copy asks: 1) prefer "deploy button" wording vs "deploy now" 2) add a one-line SDK v5->v6 migration callout (example: `client.generate` -> `client.create_completion`) 3) keep the quickstart to one visible screen on mobile.
zara: applied all three. added migration callout with one-liners: `// v5: client.generate(...)` -> `// v6: client.create_completion(...)`

paul.m: for the CodeSandbox embed, use the "embed" param so it doesn't show the sidebar. also make the example response compact JSON {"id":"r_sa","out":"Hi"} so it renders inline.

zara: updated the sandbox url and compacted the response. added a short CORS note: "Browser demos require a proxy or the hosted playground to keep tokens private; see Security guide."

link-bot: linkcheck failed: broken anchor -> /docs/sdk/v6#create-completion (404)

zara: fix incoming  replacing anchor with /docs/sdk/v6/api#completions and updating the migration link. pushing.

ci-bot: mdx-compile passed, lint passed, linkcheck passed for PR #612 :white_check_mark:

paul.m: small nit: change badge alt text to "Deploy to GitHub Pages" and use `/deploy?repo=redwood-inference/quicklab` format. also add a one-line troubleshooting FAQ for 401s.

zara: updated badge alt + url and added troubleshooting snippet:
```
# 401? ensure REDWOOD_API_KEY is set:
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx
# powershell: $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY='sk_test_xxx'
```

deploy-bot: PR #612 merged by zara  deployed to staging site (staging docs build queued).

paul.m: LGTM. thanks, this should make the signup flow demo much friendlier. :tada:
